references.text: The goat as a sin offering is prescribed in Leviticus as an offering for leaders who have sinned unintentionally.
At the dedication of the tabernacle, a male goat was used as a sin offering, just as with the offerings of the tribal chiefs.
The same offering of one male goat for a sin offering was given by Nahshon son of Amminadab as the first tribal offering.
Nathanel son of Zuar gave the same sin offering with one male goat at the dedication of the tabernacle.
A male goat for a sin offering is prescribed for the congregation in cases of unintentional sins.
At the New Moon festival, one male goat shall be offered as a sin offering to the Lord.
King Hezekiah commanded that male goats be offered as sin offerings for all Israel during the cleansing of the temple.
At the dedication of the temple after the exile, male goats were offered as sin offerings for all Israel.
